newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Chicago Miniature Lamp.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Chicago Miniature Lamp.

text.p: - McDonald & Co said Monday it reinitiated Chicago Miniature Lamp Inc at aggressive buy. The stock was at 30-3/4, off 1/4.
- Analyst Michael Linsky said in a report the niche lighting firm is vertically integrated and has strong product innovation capability and relatively low operations costs.
- He estimated the company will earn $0.81 a share this year and $1.07 in 1997 versus $0.61 in 1995, adding that if the company makes acquisitions, earnings could be higher.
- He said his 12- to 18-month price target is about $40.
